input.plan:
# Combat Asset Inclusion + Optimization Plan

## Goal
Ensure your updated combat assets are actually used in-game, then optimize them to match your direction:
- Normal symbol rendering uses lightweight imports (128 cap).
- Power-activation presentation keeps high-res quality (720 behavior).
- Flat background style is preserved (no forced transparency workflow).

## Scope and Files
- Verify symbol source bindings in [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/data/symbols](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/data/symbols)
- Adjust combat texture import policy in [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/art/placeholders](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/art/placeholders)
- Confirm runtime usage/scale behavior in [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scenes/symbol.tscn](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scenes/symbol.tscn), [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/symbol_slot.gd](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/symbol_slot.gd), and [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd)
- If needed for power moments, introduce dedicated hi-res texture references under [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/data/symbols](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/data/symbols) and consume them from [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd)

## Implementation Steps
1. Audit current symbol assets and imports to confirm each `sym_*.tres` points to your updated files and identify any mixed-size outliers.
2. Apply import size limit = 128 for regular combat symbol textures so grid rendering uses reduced memory/bandwidth.
3. Preserve or add a hi-res path for power-symbol activation visuals so activation effects can use 720-quality textures.
4. Verify no script/scene path still references stale placeholder assets or old low-res assumptions that break layout/animation.
5. Run combat test scene and validate:
   - Grid symbol quality remains acceptable at gameplay size.
   - Power activation visuals are visibly sharper than regular grid symbols.
   - Flat background style remains consistent.
6. Document the asset policy (regular=128 cap, power moments=hi-res) in combat notes to avoid regressions.

## Validation Checklist
- Symbol resources resolve to intended updated art.
- Regular symbols do not load full-res textures unnecessarily.
- Power activation uses hi-res asset path.
- No unexpected aliasing or scaling artifacts in combat flow.
- No new script/runtime warnings in combat test.

## Risks and Mitigations
- Risk: If one texture is reused for both grid and power activation, a global import cap may blur power visuals.
  - Mitigation: Use separate asset files or dedicated hi-res references for power visuals.
- Risk: Mixed asset dimensions can produce inconsistent perceived padding/weight.
  - Mitigation: Normalize canvas framing conventions across symbol art exports.
